messages.subject: Spring 2019 Meeting Time Poll
parts:
It's time to decide when we will meet during Spring quarter. Please navigate to the poll below and let us know when you're available. We'd also love to hear any topics you'd like to see covered this quarter, and whether you would be willing to present. Please respond by Friday, March 15. We will announce our new time the following week!

https://goo.gl/forms/sev1s47xAyQD4DrF3

youRs,
Taylor

---------
Taylor Reiter
PhD Candidate
Food Science Graduate Group
Lab for Data Intensive Biology
University of California, Davis
